purpose: Guide independent post-run judgment of the VP4 profile-stack screen without providing semantic feedback to the Actor.
rules: Judge each row independently after the Actor process has ended and the row evidence has been sealed.
Cite retained evidence for every observed claim.
Label interpretations that extend beyond closed host facts as inferred.
Use unresolved when retained evidence cannot support a judgment.
Do not convert aesthetic preference or an unstated design choice into a failure.
Do not feed any judgment, question, disposition, or expected answer back to the Actor during the cohort.

questions.text: Did the final definition produce exactly the integer Levels control value as closed rectangular profiles?
Do retained observations support horizontal profiles whose XY centroids align on one vertical axis with even Level Spacing in Z?
Do Width, Depth, Levels, and Level Spacing materially govern the intended profile stack?
Did the model exercise at least one consequential control, observe its effect, and restore the chosen defaults?
Did the model stop at the requested profile stack without lofting, surfacing, baking, or creating downstream geometry?
